coverage_notes: Coverage goal 80% was not met: 73.3% supported. All planned candidates within the scene budget were prepared; missing data remain explicit.
limitations: Bandpass adjustment on ordinary SR is partial harmonization; no BRDF normalization or common atmospheric reprocessing.
Daily mosaics represent a UTC day, not a simultaneous multi-sensor exposure.
Interpolation is allowed only between clear observations within max_gap_days, can smear change, and never extrapolates.
Search limits/truncation are retained; these scenes do not guarantee complete temporal or AOI coverage.

adjustment.method: HLS V2 linear MSI-to-OLI bandpass coefficients applied to surface reflectance
adjustment.limitations: Spectral adjustment only. No BRDF normalization, common atmospheric reprocessing or image-based co-registration; not an HLS-equivalent product.

pca.method: Centered covariance PCA; no per-band standardization or whitening
pca.sign_convention: Largest absolute loading in each component is positive

vca.projection_selection: Explicit projection branch selected by caller; SNR not estimated

fcls.method: Unweighted fully constrained least squares; enumerate simplex faces with convex optimality certificate

limitations: A scene-specific exploratory fit on QA-valid observed spectra; no independent material labels or held-out accuracy evaluation.
VCA assumes linear mixtures and pure pixels. Extreme spectra may represent illumination, residual atmosphere/cloud or anomalies; endmembers are numbered, not assigned material names.
FCLS fractions describe the selected geometric library. Small reconstruction residual and an optimization certificate do not validate physical material fractions.
Reflectance is the run's prepared common-grid product, including any recorded bandpass transform. Residual misregistration, BRDF and atmospheric differences remain.
PCA covariance eigenvectors describe variance, not noise removal or physical variables. Reuse a declared training basis for cross-date comparisons; no MNF/noise whitening is performed.
